name: MonarchAiAutofillField
title: AiAutofillField
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Column around any form control, with Modifier.drawBehind for the marker bar, an androidx.compose.foundation.layout.FlowRow of MonarchAiGeneratedBadge, MonarchAiConfidenceMeter and Text, and MonarchButton for Accept and Clear
summary: A form field that AI filled in: the app's control, marked with the AI badge and a confidence badge, where the value came from, and Accept and Clear.
whenToUse: Around each field an assistant filled from a document, an email or earlier answers, until the person has checked it.
whenNotToUse: Not for inline completion while typing (use MonarchAiGhostText). Not for a whole AI answer (use the conversation components).
api: @Composable public fun MonarchAiAutofillField(state: MonarchAiAutofillState, suggestion: String, onAccept: () -> Unit, onClear: () -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, fieldName: String? = null, source: String? = null, confidence: Float? = null, lowThreshold: Float = 0.6f, highThreshold: Float = 0.85f, confidenceExplanation: String? = null, model: String? = null, dateMillis: Long? = null, enabled: Boolean = true, labels: MonarchAiAutofillFieldLabels = MonarchAiAutofillFieldLabels(), control: @Composable () -> Unit)
public enum class MonarchAiAutofillState { Suggested, Accepted, Edited, Cleared }

public class MonarchAiAutofillFieldLabels(badge: ((MonarchAiAutofillState) -> String)? = null, accept: String? = null, clear: String? = null, acceptField: ((String) -> String)? = null, clearField: ((String) -> String)? = null, source: ((String) -> String)? = null, original: ((String) -> String)? = null, accepted: String? = null, cleared: String? = null)

options.name: state
options.description: Where the field stands: suggested, accepted, edited or cleared. The app drives it.

options.name: suggestion
options.description: The value AI suggested, shown as "AI suggested: …" once the person edits it.

options.name: onAccept
options.description: The person accepted the value: set state to accepted.

options.name: onClear
options.description: The person cleared the value: empty the control and set state to cleared.

options.name: fieldName
options.description: The field's name, so the actions are read as "Accept suggested Company".

options.name: source
options.description: Where the value came from, shown as "From …" until the person edits it.

options.name: confidence
options.description: How sure the AI is, 0 through 1, shown as a MonarchAiConfidenceMeter badge while suggested.

options.name: lowThreshold / highThreshold
options.description: The confidence band edges, passed to MonarchAiConfidenceMeter.

options.name: confidenceExplanation
options.description: Why the AI chose the value, read with the confidence badge.

options.name: model / dateMillis
options.description: The model and the time in epoch milliseconds, read with the AI badge.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the badge texts, the action texts and names, the source and original lines and the announcements.

states.name: suggested
states.description: A bar in the AI border color at the start edge; "AI suggested", the confidence badge, the source, and Accept and Clear.

states.name: accepted
states.description: "AI filled" and the source; no actions.

states.name: edited
states.description: "Edited by you" and "AI suggested: …" with the original value.

states.name: cleared
states.description: The control alone; the status line is gone.

appearance: The status line uses the AI generated badge and the confidence badge as they are elsewhere, with the muted caption text. The marker bar uses the AI border role. All colors are theme roles, so dark and both high-contrast themes follow.
platformNotes: Same parameters as iOS with Android types (Float confidence, epoch milliseconds) and an added enabled. The web tints the input itself with the AI subtle background and border; a Compose control's inner field cannot be restyled from outside, so Android draws a bar in the AI border color at the start edge while suggested, as iOS does. The web notices typing through the input event and calls onEdit; Compose has no such event for any control, so the app sets edited in its own onValueChange (see the example). The web moves focus back to the control after Accept and Clear; Android announces the result instead.
accessibility: The control keeps its own label, value and role.
The status line is one merged TalkBack element read after the control, made of the badge, the confidence and the source text.
Accept and Clear are buttons named with the field, such as "Accept suggested Company", with 48dp touch targets.
After Accept or Clear, "Suggestion accepted" or "Suggestion cleared" is announced through a polite live region.
The suggested state is in words (the badge), so the marker bar's color is not the only signal.
edgeCases: A long source wraps onto its own line.
With no confidence and no source, the status line is the badge alone, followed by the actions.
If the app never sets edited, the field keeps saying "AI suggested" after the person types.
